startUrls.title: Post URLs
startUrls.description: Public Instagram post/reel URLs (instagram.com/p/... or /reel/...) or Facebook post URLs.

maxComments.title: Max comments per post
maxComments.description: Stop collecting top-level comments for a post after this many. Replies (see Include replies) come on top.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Click each 'View all N replies' link and save the replies too, right under their parent comment. Adds one request per thread.

maxLoadMoreRounds.title: Max load-more rounds per post
maxLoadMoreRounds.description: Optional. How many times to click 'load more' or scroll the comments panel. Each round adds about 7 comments. Leave empty to work it out from Max comments.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Time limit per post (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Optional. If a post takes longer, its results are lost and it is retried. Leave empty to allow about 7 s per round plus 60 s.

saveRawResponses.title: Save raw network responses (debug)
saveRawResponses.description: Store every captured JSON response in the key-value store so you can study the structure and write parsers.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended for Instagram and Facebook.

sessionStatePath.title: Session file path (local runs)
sessionStatePath.description: Optional. Path to a Playwright storage-state file made by scripts/save_session.py with a spare Instagram account. Leave empty to scrape logged out.

sessionState.title: Session state JSON (platform runs)
sessionState.description: Optional. Contents of the session file, for runs on the Apify platform. Stored encrypted. Takes precedence over sessionStatePath.
